figurative_meaning_en: Loss of mental capacity or ability to think due to excessive worry
example_sentences_in_bangla: পরীক্ষার চাপে ছেলেটার ঘিলু শুকিয়ে যাবে বলে মনে হচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has lost his mental sharpness due to constant worry.
The pressure of the exam is making the boy lose his ability to think clearly.
note: The idiom draws from the imagery of the brain (ghilu) drying out like parched earth under stress, common in Bengali folk expressions.
